name: Dendrite Python Sdk
headline: Dendrite Python SDK for Web AI Agents
short_description: The dendrite-python-sdk provides powerful tools for building web AI agents capable of authenticating, interacting with, and extracting data from any website. This SDK is ideal for developers looking to automate web tasks and enhance their AI applications.
author: dendrite-systems

sections.overview:
Dendrite is an open-source Python SDK that enables AI agents to browse and interact with websites using natural language instructions. The framework handles authentication, element interaction, structured data extraction, file downloads, and anti-blocking measures—allowing developers to build web automation tools without APIs. It works with Claude and other LLMs through a simple async interface. Dendrite caches extracted scripts for reuse and self-healing when websites update. While no longer under active development, the fully open-source codebase remains available for learning, forking, and adaptation.
Automating data collection from competitor websites
Building chatbots that interact with web services
Creating agents for market research by scraping data
Integrating web data into CRM systems
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
